settings: Choose which emails you get under Profile.
settingsDigest: Choose which other emails you get under Profile.

reason.attester: You get this email because you can attest the expense.
reason.submitter: You get this email because you submitted the expense.
reason.bookkeeper: You get this email because you book the section's expenses.
reason.cardHolder: You get this email because section card {cards} is in your name.
reason.digest: The summary comes every Sunday when something is waiting for you, and never otherwise.

submitted.subject: To attest: {label}
submitted.heading: {actor} has submitted an expense
submitted.intro: It is waiting for your attest.

changesRequested.subject: Changes requested: {label}
changesRequested.heading: Your expense came back
changesRequested.intro: {actor} wants you to change something before it can be attested. Change it and submit it again, and it goes on.

waiverRevoked.subject: Exemption revoked: {label}
waiverRevoked.heading: The exemption from the filing deadline is removed
waiverRevoked.intro: An out-of-pocket expense older than {days} days cannot be submitted without it.

waived.subject: Exemption granted: {label}
waived.heading: Your expense may be submitted even though it is late
waived.intro: {actor} has granted an exemption from the filing deadline.

costCenterApproved.subject: Partly attested: {label}
costCenterApproved.heading: {actor} has attested {costCenter}
costCenterApproved.intro: The rest of the expense is still waiting for attest.

readyToBook.subject: To book: {label}
readyToBook.heading: An expense from {submitter} is attested
readyToBook.intro: It is waiting to be booked.

attestWithdrawn.subject: Attest withdrawn: {label}
attestWithdrawn.heading: {actor} has withdrawn their attest
attestWithdrawn.intro: The expense is waiting for attest again.

recalled.subject: Recalled: {label}
recalled.heading: {actor} has recalled the expense
recalled.intro: It is no longer in the attest queue, so you do not need to do anything with it for now.

exported.subject: Done: {label}
exported.heading: Your expense is done
exported.intro: It is booked and sent to Fortnox.

exportReverted.subject: Export undone: {label}
exportReverted.heading: {actor} has marked the expense as not exported
exportReverted.intro: The voucher is still in Fortnox and may need correcting there.

cardTransactions.subject: {count, plural, one {# new card transaction} other {# new card transactions}} on your section card
cardTransactions.heading: {count, plural, one {# new transaction} other {# new transactions}} on your card
cardTransactions.intro: Every purchase needs an expense with a receipt, and every refund an expense showing what was returned.

digest.subject: Your weekly summary: {count, plural, one {# thing is} other {# things are}} waiting for you
digest.heading: Hi {name}, this is waiting for you
digest.unmatchedHint: Every transaction on the section card needs an expense, refunds too.
digest.deadline: Out-of-pocket expenses close to the filing deadline
digest.deadlineHint: An out-of-pocket expense must be submitted within {days} days of the purchase. After that it cannot be paid out.
digest.deadlineLeft: {left, plural, =0 {Last day today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
digest.attestSub: From {submitter}, waited {days, plural, =0 {less than a day} one {# day} other {# days}}
